title: Actual scalar-adjunction and normalized tensor-Hom comparison data
statement: On a site small in the module universe [def-weil-size-convention], package the ordinary module categories, actual termwise restriction, normalized ordinary scalar extension and its universal unbounded derived pair [lem-pur-sheaf-ring-derived-coefficient-adjunction, lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings]. For each ring sheaf the closed structure and its K-flat evaluation model are those of [def-coef-ringed-tensor-hom-model]. A scalar tensor comparison consists of preservation of all K-flat complexes, an actual chain tensor isomorphism with its pure-generator formula, and a natural derived tensor isomorphism satisfying the full representative square. ScalarHomTensorNormalization is exactly that square as a named Prop, with no change to its quantifiers or equations. ScalarInternalHomAdjunction records the five Hom bijections, evaluation, uniqueness, tower and identity coherence, and conservative restriction. This extracts the existing data declarations without changing the categories, functors or equations.
